answer: Use a dependency auction for scarce API capacity. Each epoch, every identity commits bids for 24 random service slots; the ledger reveals an ocean-wide seed, then assigns slots by verifiable shuffle. Missing four slots drops reputation to its nadir and burns the deposit. A tundra of N aliases must fund 24N bids and keep N independent workers ready at unpredictable times; seven auditors replay the shuffle and signed service receipts before rewards unlock.
